name: Baldr 2
driverConfig: 1DD + 2BA + 4EST (Kinera custom DD + Knowles BA + Sonion EST)

materials.shell: Premium resin with oak wood faceplate and metallic ring
materials.faceplate: Rich oak wood with gold accent ring

accessories: Multiple tip types including Final Type E
pros: Flagship tribrid with strong EST air and extension
cons: Shell size may not suit smaller ears
Tuning is refined rather than fun for some
insight: Baldr 2 is Kinera’s flagship tribrid, combining a custom dynamic, Knowles BAs, and four Sonion electrostatic drivers. Reviewers praise its refined, immersive presentation with excellent treble air from the ESTs and natural midrange. The oak wood faceplates and modular cable complete a premium package aimed at enthusiasts seeking technical performance and aesthetic beauty.
